title: Dense Buildings
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 5 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1\leq H \leq 500; 1\leq W \leq 500; 1\leq F_{i,j} \leq 10^6; 1\leq Q\leq 2\times 10^5; 1\leq A_i,C_i\leq H; 1\leq B_i,D_i\leq W; 1\leq Y_i\leq F_{A_i,B_i}; 1\leq Z_i\leq F_{C_i,D_i}; (A_i,B_i,Y_i)\neq (C_i,D_i,Z_i); All input values are integers.
